description: This software is designed to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. It continuously tracks heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, oxygen levels, and sleep patterns using sensors.
summary: To build health monitoring software for astronauts on long-duration space missions (such as lunar or Martian travel), the system must function autonomously, handle communication delays, and support non-physician crew members.
